Write IUPAC names of the following compounds:

(i) \((\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CH}-\text{CH}=\text{CH}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}=\text{CH}-\text{CH}(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5)-\text{CH}_3\)

(ii) the bond-line structure shown in the figure

(iii) \(\text{CH}_2=\text{C}(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)_2\)

(iv) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}=\text{C}(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_3\)
_note: The book draws (i) and (iv) as two-line skeletal structures; they are given here in condensed linear form. In (iv) the attachment points of the butyl and ethyl branches were fixed by chemistry: only butyl on the first CH and ethyl on the doubly bonded C give a ten-carbon parent, which is what the book's own answer (dec-4-ene) requires. (ii) is printed only as a zig-zag bond-line drawing and is carried as a figure.

stem: Calculate number of sigma (\(\sigma\)) and pi (\(\pi\)) bonds in the above structures (i-iv).
context: The four structures are those of Problem 9.7: (i) \((\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CH}-\text{CH}=\text{CH}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}=\text{CH}-\text{CH}(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5)-\text{CH}_3\); (ii) the bond-line octatetraene; (iii) \(\text{CH}_2=\text{C}(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)_2\); (iv) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}=\text{C}(\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_3\).
solution:
(i) \(\sigma\) bonds : 33, \(\pi\) bonds : 2

(ii) \(\sigma\) bonds : 17, \(\pi\) bonds : 4

(iii) \(\sigma\) bonds : 23, \(\pi\) bond : 1

(iv) \(\sigma\) bonds : 41, \(\pi\) bond : 1

stem: Write structures and IUPAC names of different structural isomers of alkenes corresponding to \(\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10}\).

Draw cis and trans isomers of the following compounds. Also write their IUPAC names :

(i) \(\text{CHCl}=\text{CHCl}\)

(ii) \(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{CCH}_3=\text{CCH}_3\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\)
solution:
(i) With both H atoms on the same side of the double bond (and hence both Cl atoms on the same side) the isomer is cis-1,2-dichloroethene; with one H and one Cl on each side of the double bond the isomer is trans-1,2-dichloroethene.

(ii) With both \(\text{CH}_3\) groups on the same side of the double bond (and both \(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\) groups on the other side) the isomer is cis-3,4-dimethylhex-3-ene; with one \(\text{CH}_3\) and one \(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\) on each side the isomer is trans-3,4-dimethylhex-3-ene.
_note: The book gives the solution as four drawn structures with the two groups written above and below each doubly bonded carbon; the arrangement is stated here in words, with the book's own IUPAC names retained verbatim.

stem:
Which of the following compounds will show cis-trans isomerism?

(i) \((\text{CH}_3)_2\text{C}=\text{CH}-\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\)

(ii) \(\text{CH}_2=\text{CBr}_2\)

(iii) \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}=\text{CH}-\text{CH}_3\)

(iv) \(\text{CH}_3\text{CH}=\text{CCl}\,\text{CH}_3\)
solution: (iii) and (iv). In structures (i) and (ii), two identical groups are attached to one of the doubly bonded carbon atoms.

Write structures of different isomers corresponding to the 5th member of alkyne series. Also write IUPAC names of all the isomers. What type of isomerism is exhibited by different pairs of isomers?
solution:
The 5th member of the alkyne series has the molecular formula \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\). The possible isomers are:

(a) \(\text{HC}\equiv\text{C}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) — Hex-1-yne

(b) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}\equiv\text{C}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) — Hex-2-yne

(c) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{C}\equiv\text{C}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) — Hex-3-yne

(d) \(\text{HC}\equiv\text{C}-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) — 3-Methylpent-1-yne

(e) \(\text{HC}\equiv\text{C}-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_3\) — 4-Methylpent-1-yne

(f) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}\equiv\text{C}-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_3\) — 4-Methylpent-2-yne

(g) \(\text{HC}\equiv\text{C}-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_2-\text{CH}_3\) — 3,3-Dimethylbut-1-yne

Position and chain isomerism are shown by different pairs.
